statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-42821 was fixed upstream in github.com/gomarkdown/markdown at 0.0.0-20230922105210-14b16010c2ee. This image was updated to ship github.com/gomarkdown/markdown@0.0.0-20260411013819-759bbc3e3207 for the temporal CLI, which is newer than the upstream fix and therefore already contains the remediation. The vulnerable parser.Mmark citation parsing code from pre-fix versions is not present in the package version shipped here.
